title: 'None of our MPs will split': Sharad Pawar's bold assertion in season of defections
summary: Sharad Pawar confidently asserts his Nationalist Congress Party (SP) will remain united, dismissing claims of MPs defecting to Ajit Pawar's faction. His daughter, Supriya Sule, challenged the accuser to name the alleged defectors.
